_known_issues: search pipeline (subtask 03.3): amazon's SEARCH_BOOK_DETAIL_LINK selector (a.a-link-normal.s-line-clamp-2.s-link-style.a-text-normal) no longer matches live result cards, so raw_href is None for every card and both url and asin come out None - even though data-asin is present on the card, it is only read inside the link branch. This is exactly the selector-drift this corpus exists to catch.

search pipeline (subtask 03.3): amazon pagination iterates range(1, SEARCH_MAXIMUM_PAGES) with no next-button handling; SEARCH_NEXT_PAGE_SELECTOR is defined but never read, so the disabled-next-button state has no effect on where scraping stops.
